_schema.nan_encoding: NaN and infinities serialise as null; an unreliable band carries unreliable=true and unreliable_reason alongside the nulls
_schema.val_bce: binary_cross_entropy_with_logits, reduction = sum over all (sequence, code) pairs divided by their count (element mean), pos_weight = null, no masking: every code is a valid target for every sequence. Identical for every arm. val_bce_batch_mean_of_means is the mean of per-batch means, reported only for continuity with train.json's series.
_schema.micro_auprc: streaming fixed-edge score histogram over all (sequence, code) pairs; edges shared by every arm; ties within a bin are treated as tied, as sklearn does
_schema.macro_auprc: per-code average precision averaged over codes with at least min_pos positives in this stratum. Excluded codes are excluded, never imputed.
_schema.recall: per sequence, denominator = number of true codes in the target visit, capped_at_k = False; averaged over sequences. Sequences with no true codes are NaN and counted separately.
_schema.ndcg@20: binary relevance, 1/log2(i+1) discount, ideal DCG over min(|true|, 20)
_schema.train_json_val_bce: the run's own per-epoch validation loss, computed during training on --val_max_batches batches only; it is NOT the val_bce used for selection here
_schema.gradient_probe: forward+backward on fixed validation batches; optimizer.step is never called and the checkpoint is not mutated
_schema.kernel_separation: log w curves centered per age over the tau grid before comparison, because softmax ignores a per-row constant

harness.batch_order_hash_definition: blake2b-128 over (lengths, code_indices, target nonzero indices) of every batch in order

tau_max.source: checkpoint buffer via DKMModel.tau_max; never re-derived

histogram_edges.source: min/max logit over 8 validation batches at every one of the 44 checkpoints, widened by 2.0

targets.band_definition: age at the last valid event of each validation sequence

gram_condition_numbers.distribution: empirical within-window pairwise lags on the val split, 400 sampled windows

corpus_stats.tau_max_source: exact max over full val split, N=52227 windows, of log1p(span_days/7); stored with 1 ulp of float32 headroom (float64 value 6.712087918951945)

gradient_probe.loss_reduction: mean over the K probe batches of the per-batch mean BCE

dense_uniform_grid.support: uniform grid on [0, 90], 181 points -- what the pathway CAN do

empirical_validation.support: age at the last valid event of every validation sequence -- what it does on data
